parts.name: Switch (Right Button)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch button of a wall switch, made of ABS plastic, rectangular in shape, and designed for tactile pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one of the main control buttons to open or close an electrical circuit, typically for lighting or appliances.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or depressing inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch (Left Button)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch button of a wall switch, made of ABS plastic, similar in size and shape to the right button.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as an independent control for another circuit, allowing separate operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns outward when released, typically through a spring or rocker mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch buttons and internal electrical components securely, and mounts the switch assembly to the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation; it serves as a fixed housing for the moving parts.
